item.title: Tesla recalls 3 million cars as part of China-wide push to stop hidden door handles
item.description: Tesla and eight other automakers will install warning labels that help occupants identify the often hard-to-find manual door releases.

item.title: Digital camera sales are up, and Fujifilm just leapfrogged Nikon — here's what the numbers tell us
item.description: A new Nikkei report is encouraging reading for the camera industry, particularly Canon and Nikon —here's what we can learn from the data.

item.title: Private equity firm Apollo confirms data breach amid hacking wave targeting financial giants
item.description: The private equity giant confirms a breach, weeks after Google researchers said hackers were targeting financial companies.

item.title: Santé, tech et design : à quoi ressemble (vraiment) un bon sextoy masculin en 2026 ? [Sponso]
item.description: Longtemps considéré comme honteux, le masturbateur masculin a su se réinventer pour s’intégrer au quotidien de manière naturelle et assumée. En 2026, le sextoy pour homme donne du plaisir, mais c'est en plus un objet technologique et esthétique.

item.title: Augmentation du prix de YouTube Premium en Europe : n’ignorez pas le mail qui annonce la hausse
item.description: Des internautes de plusieurs pays européens reçoivent en ce moment des mails annonçant que leur abonnement YouTube Premium va augmenter. Le message comporte une précision qu'il ne faut pas manquer.

item.title: Security experts targeted by fake crypto conference in scam to hand over details
item.description: Cybersecurity pros attending conferences are being targeted with AMOS and other infostealers, experts warn.

item.title: L’excellente alternative au Galaxy Z Fold perd 600 € : le Honor Magic V6 brade son prix avec un tas de cadeaux
item.description: Honor frappe fort : son Magic V6, taillé pour faire de l'ombre à Samsung, est déjà en promotion. Grâce à une remise XXL de 600 euros accompagnée d'une pluie de cadeaux, ce nouveau pliant devient le bon plan incontournable du moment.

item.title: Senator asks US government watchdog to review how feds use hacking tools
item.description: Senator Ron Wyden sent a letter to the U.S. federal watchdog requesting a comprehensive review of how the FBI, DEA, ICE's HSI, and the Secret Service use hacking tools and spyware against Americans.

item.title: Chang'e 7 : la Chine part « bondir » dans les zones les plus secrètes du pôle sud de la Lune où s’installeront les Américains
item.description: Dans quelques jours, une nouvelle sonde spatiale va partir en direction de la Lune. Pas encore une mission habitée, mais une étape supplémentaire décisive pour la Chine qui vise cette fois le pôle sud de notre satellite.

item.title: Child safety experts are skeptical of OpenAI's ChatGPT for Teens
item.description: They say the company must prove it can be trusted before products like these get a pass.

item.description: There's no need to wait for Labor Day; Best Buy's massive Anniversary sale has record-low prices that you can shop right now on TVs, appliances, laptops, AirPods, and more.

item.description: Après les Apple Watch et les Samsung Galaxy Watch, les Google Pixel Watch sont désormais compatibles avec l'option eSIM Watch de Free.

item.title: Tech is helping grocery stores waste less food. That’s a problem for food banks
item.description: As supermarkets adopt new tools to predict demand and reduce food waste, food banks say that donations are also shrinking. First, the good news: Grocery stores are getting better at cutting food waste. AI tools can help better predict demand for each product, for example, and help a store reduce waste by more than a third. Other tech can help stores sell food before it expires....

item.title: Bose SoundLink Max : l’enceinte nomade ultime pour vos soirées perd 30 % sur Amazon
item.description: Si vous cherchez l'enceinte parfaite pour mettre l'ambiance, la Bose SoundLink Max coche toutes les cases. Avec sa robustesse à toute épreuve et ses 20 heures de batterie, elle promet de faire vibrer vos soirées jusqu'au bout de la nuit. La très bonne nouvelle ? Amazon fait tomber son prix à 279 euros au lieu de 399 euros.

item.title: Crypto stocks head for their second day of gains as Bitcoin and other tokens rise: Will the rally keep going?
item.description: Companies including Coinbase Global, Circle Internet Group, and even mining firms like MARA have been riding a wave of fresh market enthusiasm. Yesterday, cryptocurrencies across the board, including major tokens such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP, received a much-needed boost.

Livebox, décodeur, Flybox : on vous détaille la nouvelle grille complète et les réflexes à adopter pour ne rien payer....

item.title: Forget Wetherspoons — patchwork bans won't fix the Meta glasses' privacy crisis, so what comes next?
item.description: With activists pushing back and venue bans multiplying, Britain's Meta glasses privacy crisis has reached a boiling point, leaving policymakers balancing a complex legal nightmare: public safety vs consumer rights.

item.title: Tesla sunsets its Solar Roof tiles
item.description: Tesla has discontinued Solar Roof, its solar panels designed to look like regular roofing tiles, Electrek reports. Sources "close to the program" told the publication that Tesla has informed its third-party installer network that Solar Roof is no longer available to order, and that only conventional solar panels will be supplied going forward. While Tesla […]...

item.title: Does generative AI actually copy artists? Researchers say it’s up for debate
item.description: Researchers from MIT unpack the idea of ‘attribution decay,’ and what it might mean for artists looking to protect their work. Generative AI has long been accused of copying artists’ work outright (see the numerous copyright lawsuits winding their way through court). But a new study out of MIT makes a very different argument—one that could complicate how those cases hold up....
